description: Seller: resolve a reported problem by sending a replacement (with new tracking information). Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

tracking.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters
